name: vc-init
description: Onboarding for the Virto Commerce QA plugins — /project-init asks only the environment name, bug tracker, code host and an auth preference, derives the rest from a live scan, and is the ONLY writer of project-profile.json. Every token it needs (GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jira) is stored by vc-secrets and handed to a process at launch through the $VC_RUN bridge, so no token sits in .env.local, .mcp.json or a settings env block. vc-fix and vc-perf depend on it.
